title: revlens analysis structure
description: analysis/structure.json in the analysis repository: what the document is and which files are its chapters, in reading order. The engagement adapter reads it at the baseline revision and at the head, which is how a bundle can say it compares version 1.6 against version 1.5.

language.description: ISO 639-1 code, e.g. cs or en

version.description: Version of the text at this commit; the baseline's value becomes document.baseline.version in the bundle

chapters.description: Chapters in reading order; a file not listed here is not part of the document

id.description: Chapter id the bundle and the comments refer to

file.description: Path of the chapter file relative to analysis/

order.description: Reading order; ties fall back to file order
